item.title: Setting the Standard: Charting EC One’s ESG journey
item.description: Retail Jeweller Setting the Standard: Charting EC One’s ESG journey When it comes to leading the way with responsible practices, there are few jewellery businesses that can compete with EC One. Ruth Faulkner speaks to co-founders Alison and Jos Skeates about the next step in this London-based independent’s ESG journey. Setting the Standard: Charting EC One’s ESG journey Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Orient Star marks 75th anniversary with series of limited edition timepieces
item.description: Retail Jeweller Orient Star marks 75th anniversary with series of limited edition timepieces Watch brand Orient Star is marking 75 years of mechanical watchmaking with the introduction of a series of 75th Anniversary Limited Edition models, set to launch in limited quantities throughout 2026. Orient Star marks 75th anniversary with series of limited edition timepieces Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Historic Birmingham jewellery manufacturer files notice of intention to appoint administrators
item.description: Retail Jeweller Historic Birmingham jewellery manufacturer files notice of intention to appoint administrators A historic Birmingham jewellery and metalwork manufacturer has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators, raising concerns over the future of one of the Jewellery Quarter’s long established businesses. Historic Birmingham jewellery manufacturer files notice of intention to appoint administrators Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Vacheron Constantin expands Overseas collection with titanium tourbillon model Watch brand Vacheron Constantin has added to its Overseas collection with the launch of a new tourbillon model in titanium. item.description: Retail Jeweller Tiffany & Co launches new HardWear campaign starring Alison Oliver Tiffany & Co has launched a new campaign celebrating its HardWear by Tiffany collection, starring Irish actress and House Ambassador Alison Oliver. Tiffany & Co launches new HardWear campaign starring Alison Oliver Ruth Faulkner

item.title: De Beers and Assouline publish centenary book celebrating cultural legacy of diamonds
item.description: Retail Jeweller De Beers and Assouline publish centenary book celebrating cultural legacy of diamonds De Beers Group has partnered with luxury publisher Assouline to release a new book titled A Diamond Is Forever The Making of a Cultural Icon, marking 100 years of the business and celebrating the enduring cultural significance of diamonds. De Beers and Assouline publish centenary book celebrating cultural legacy of diamonds Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Watches of Switzerland Group reports strong Q3 trading with positive growth in UK and US
item.description: Retail Jeweller Watches of Switzerland Group reports strong Q3 trading with positive growth in UK and US Watches of Switzerland Group has reported strong trading for the third quarter of FY26, with continued positive sales growth across both the UK and US and performance ahead of expectations during the key holiday period. Watches of Switzerland Group reports strong Q3 trading with positive growth in UK and US Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Chelmsford jeweller to close store after more than 50 years
item.description: Retail Jeweller Chelmsford jeweller to close store after more than 50 years Independent retailer Krafft Jewellers has announced it will close its Chelmsford store after more than five decades in business, citing challenging trading conditions, rising costs and the continued growth of online shopping. Chelmsford jeweller to close store after more than 50 years Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Edinburgh Assay Office announces inaugural award winner The Edinburgh Assay Office has revealed the recipient of its inaugural Edinburgh Assay Office Award, a new initiative launched in 2025 to support a sustainable future for contemporary silversmithing in Scotland. Edinburgh Assay Office announces inaugural award winner Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Georg Jensen expands flagship store at The Royal Exchange
item.description: Retail Jeweller Georg Jensen expands flagship store at The Royal Exchange Danish jewellery brand Georg Jensen has expanded its presence at The Royal Exchange in the City of London, relocating to a larger flagship unit following strong trading performance at the luxury destination.
